title: Space bound from per-input halting times
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every binary input $x$ there is a time $T$ such that every choice word of length exactly $T$ leads to a halted configuration on $x$, and every such run uses at most $s(|x|)$ work-tape cells in total. Then for every binary input $x$ and every choice word, the run on $x$ uses at most $s(|x|)$ work-tape cells in total.
